summary: Native Count* steps (CountArmyColor/Type/Kingdom, CountArmor...) run at their own step position, usually step 0, before any damage. Engine modifier sources (alliesOfColor, enemiesOfColor, alliesOfRace, ...) are evaluated lazily when the consuming segment runs, so a unit killed by an earlier segment of the same spell is no longer counted. weapon:1158 Runeforger: CountArmyColor@AllAllies/AllEnemies Brown, then SplashHighDamage, then ExplodeGems: a Brown enemy killed by the splash must still add one explosion. Needs count sources captured at cast start (or at the native Count step position), like castStartBoardSkulls. Also troop:7492 (Undead/Daemon enemies counted before Angel-gem explosion skulls), troop:6593 (Divine enemies counted before Damage@AllEnemies kills). Where the counted segment could simply be moved ahead without an observable change (troop:7883) sa-R1 reordered the curated skill instead.
repro: castSpell({key:"weapon:1158", target:11, enemies:[{hp:600,armor:5,colors:["Red"]},{hp:1,maxHp:1,armor:0,colors:["Brown"]}]}) -> splash kills E11, then explode uses 1 centre (caster only); native: 2.

summary: troop:6964 StormKnight native order: CountArmyColor@FromTarget Blue, DestroyColumn [AddForBlueTarget], IncreaseAttack@Self, TrueDamage@FromTarget last (R001). The only available gate, lastTargetColor, needs a prior targeting segment, so the curated skill must deal the true damage first. Observable: if the chosen target is the front enemy, native column skulls hit it before the true damage; the engine kills it first and column skulls go to the next enemy. Needs a global condition on the chosen target colour (chosenTargetColor, symmetric to chosenTargetRace), then 8467 can be reordered. sa-R1 already fixed the count (target only, not all Blue enemies).
